46,359 7.4 How to read the amounts. Planned adds every line. Actual and Difference add only the lines that have an Actual amount, so they are not comparable with the
46,349 7.4 whole Planned column. Difference is Planned minus Actual: a positive amount is under plan, a minus sign (shaded, with the words OVER PLAN) is over plan.
46,339 7.4 A dash means no Actual amount has been entered.
